verdict.rationale: Sending-domain authentication is a fair question for an email service provider like Mailchimp, but the evidence pack has no documentation of SPF, DKIM or DMARC setup, guided DNS records, or domain verification. The nearest items are inbound domain routing and dedicated IP requests, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can authenticate my own sending domain — SPF, DKIM, DMARC alignment — with guided DNS setup and verification
